flagged.title: Themes: Race, Power, Love Across Lines
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly states that 'dagger' is the slur used against noughts instead of 'blanker', which is a factual error on core text vocabulary that would lose marks in an exam.

mark_affecting.quote: And then you have the noughts, who are white, treated as second-class citizens, and are targeted by the slur dagger.
